values./system/biography: An intelligent alien apex predator able to turn invisible and adapt the poison in its tail barb.
values./items/@53830a6ebf63164d/system/descript: Body + Melee (TN 16), Breaking, Piercing 1; roll on Random Xuvian Poison.
values./items/@6d181add0ad38199/system/descript: This character cannot suffer damage or effects from radiation.
values./items/@bcf1d22c8042567c/system/descript: This character cannot suffer damage or effects from poison.
values./items/@47ff24b9bbb97781/system/descript: As a minor action it becomes nearly invisible, increasing the difficulty to see it by 2 until it attacks or suffers damage.
values./items/@7bd8bad6611ff6ce/system/descript: The AP cost of a second major action is reduced by 1, but it must be a different attack.
values./items/@dd7dd85f0d132745/system/descript: As a major action it may move up to three zones.
values./items/@75dcfe5a818bbfee/system/descript: It may increase Arm Blade difficulty by 1 to add +3 DC damage.
values./items/@2dc8058e982cdfa2/system/descript: It can climb walls easily but cannot remain hanging from a ceiling.
